fr_laxincense.name: Lax Incense
fr_laxincense.description: An item to be held by a POKéMON. Its tricky aroma slightly reduces the foe’s accuracy.

fr_luckypunch.name: Lucky Punch
fr_luckypunch.description: A glove to be held by a CHANSEY. It raises CHANSEY’s critical-hit ratio.

fr_metalpowder.name: Metal Powder
fr_metalpowder.description: A fine, hard powder to be held by a DITTO. It raises DITTO’s DEFENSE stat.

fr_thickclub.name: Thick Club
fr_thickclub.description: A hard bone of some sort to be held by a CUBONE or MAROWAK. It raises the ATTACK stat.

fr_stick.name: Stick
fr_stick.description: A stick of leek to be held by a FARFETCH’D. It raises FARFETCH’D’s critical-hit ratio.

fr_redscarf.name: Red Scarf
fr_redscarf.description: An item to be held by a POKéMON. It boosts the holding POKéMON’s COOL condition in CONTESTS.

fr_bluescarf.name: Blue Scarf
fr_bluescarf.description: An item to be held by a POKéMON. It boosts the holding POKéMON’s BEAUTY condition in CONTESTS.

fr_pinkscarf.name: Pink Scarf
fr_pinkscarf.description: An item to be held by a POKéMON. It boosts the holding POKéMON’s CUTE condition in CONTESTS.

fr_greenscarf.name: Green Scarf
fr_greenscarf.description: An item to be held by a POKéMON. It boosts the holding POKéMON’s SMART condition in CONTESTS.

fr_yellowscarf.name: Yellow Scarf
fr_yellowscarf.description: An item to be held by a POKéMON. It boosts the holding POKéMON’s TOUGH condition in CONTESTS.

fr_machbike.name: Mach Bike
fr_machbike.description: A folding bicycle that is at least twice as fast as walking.

fr_coincase.name: Coin Case
fr_coincase.description: A case for holding COINS obtained at the GAME CORNER. It holds up to 9,999 COINS.

fr_itemfinder.name: Itemfinder
fr_itemfinder.description: A device used for finding items. If there is a hidden item nearby when it is used, it emits a signal.

fr_oldrod.name: Old Rod
fr_oldrod.description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild POKéMON.

fr_goodrod.name: Good Rod
fr_goodrod.description: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild POKéMON.

fr_superrod.name: Super Rod
fr_superrod.description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild POKéMON.

fr_ssticket.name: S.S. Ticket
fr_ssticket.description: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. ANNE. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

fr_contestpass.name: Contest Pass
fr_contestpass.description: The pass required for entering POKéMON CONTESTS. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

fr_wailmerpail.name: Wailmer Pail
fr_wailmerpail.description: A nifty watering pail. Use it to promote strong growth in BERRIES planted in soft soil.

fr_devongoods.name: Devon Goods
fr_devongoods.description: A package that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the DEVON CORPORATION.

fr_sootsack.name: Soot Sack
fr_sootsack.description: A sack used to collect volcanic ash automatically during walks over deep ash.

fr_basementkey.name: Basement Key
fr_basementkey.description: The key to NEW MAUVILLE, which was constructed beneath MAUVILLE CITY.

fr_acrobike.name: Acro Bike
fr_acrobike.description: A folding bicycle that is capable of stunts like jumps and wheelies.

fr_pokeblockcase.name: Pokéblock Case
fr_pokeblockcase.description: A case for holding PokéblockS made with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases one Pokéblock when shaken.

fr_letter.name: Letter
fr_letter.description: An extremely important letter to STEVEN from the PRESIDENT of the DEVON CORPORATION.

fr_eonticket.name: Eon Ticket
fr_eonticket.description: The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to a distant southern island. It features a drawing of an island.

fr_redorb.name: Red Orb
fr_redorb.description: An orb that glows red. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.

fr_blueorb.name: Blue Orb
fr_blueorb.description: An orb that glows blue. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.

fr_scanner.name: Scanner
fr_scanner.description: A device used to search for life-forms in water. It looks too difficult to use.

fr_gogoggles.name: Go-Goggles
fr_gogoggles.description: A pair of protective goggles. They enable a TRAINER to travel through even desert sandstorms.

fr_meteorite.name: Meteorite
fr_meteorite.description: A meteorite that fell from space onto MT. MOON long ago. It is very lumpy and hard.

fr_rm1key.name: Rm. 1 Key
fr_rm1key.description: A key that opens the door to Room 1 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

fr_rm2key.name: Rm. 2 Key
fr_rm2key.description: A key that opens the door to Room 2 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

fr_rm4key.name: Rm. 4 Key
fr_rm4key.description: A key that opens the door to Room 4 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

fr_rm6key.name: Rm. 6 Key
fr_rm6key.description: A key that opens the door to Room 6 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

fr_storagekey.name: Storage Key
fr_storagekey.description: A key that opens the storage hold inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.

fr_rootfossil.name: Root Fossil
fr_rootfossil.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a plant root.

fr_clawfossil.name: Claw Fossil
fr_clawfossil.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a claw.

fr_devonscope.name: Devon Scope
fr_devonscope.description: A scope that signals the presence of any unseeable POKéMON. It is made by the DEVON CORP.

fr_tm01.name: TM01
fr_tm01.description: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.

fr_tm02.name: TM02
fr_tm02.description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

fr_tm03.name: TM03
fr_tm03.description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

fr_tm04.name: TM04
fr_tm04.description: The user focuses its mind to raise the SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.

fr_tm05.name: TM05
fr_tm05.description: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

fr_tm06.name: TM06
fr_tm06.description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

fr_tm07.name: TM07
fr_tm07.description: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all POKéMON except the ICE-type.

fr_tm08.name: TM08
fr_tm08.description: The user bulks up its body to boost both its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

fr_tm09.name: TM09
fr_tm09.description: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.

fr_tm10.name: TM10
fr_tm10.description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

fr_tm11.name: TM11
fr_tm11.description: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up FIRE-type moves.

fr_tm12.name: TM12
fr_tm12.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.

fr_tm13.name: TM13
fr_tm13.description: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.

fr_tm14.name: TM14
fr_tm14.description: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. It may freeze the foe solid.

fr_tm15.name: TM15
fr_tm15.description: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.

fr_tm16.name: TM16
fr_tm16.description: A wall of light cuts damage from SP. ATK attacks for five turns.

fr_tm17.name: TM17
fr_tm17.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

fr_tm18.name: TM18
fr_tm18.description: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER- type moves.

fr_tm19.name: TM19
fr_tm19.description: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

fr_tm20.name: TM20
fr_tm20.description: It protects the user’s party from all status problems for five turns.

fr_tm21.name: TM21
fr_tm21.description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.

fr_tm22.name: TM22
fr_tm22.description: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.

fr_tm23.name: TM23
fr_tm23.description: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe’s DEFENSE stat.

fr_tm24.name: TM24
fr_tm24.description: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

fr_tm25.name: TM25
fr_tm25.description: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

fr_tm26.name: TM26
fr_tm26.description: An earthquake that strikes all POKéMON in battle excluding the user.

fr_tm27.name: TM27
fr_tm27.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.

fr_tm28.name: TM28
fr_tm28.description: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

fr_tm29.name: TM29
fr_tm29.description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s SP. DEF stat.

fr_tm30.name: TM30
fr_tm30.description: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe’s SP. DEF.

fr_tm31.name: TM31
fr_tm31.description: An attack that also breaks any barrier like LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.

fr_tm32.name: TM32
fr_tm32.description: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

fr_tm33.name: TM33
fr_tm33.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

fr_tm34.name: TM34
fr_tm34.description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. It can’t be evaded.

fr_tm35.name: TM35
fr_tm35.description: The foe is scorched with intense flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

fr_tm36.name: TM36
fr_tm36.description: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.

fr_tm37.name: TM37
fr_tm37.description: A 5-turn sandstorm that damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.

fr_tm38.name: TM38
fr_tm38.description: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

fr_tm39.name: TM39
fr_tm39.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s SPEED if it hits.

fr_tm40.name: TM40
fr_tm40.description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can’t be evaded.

fr_tm41.name: TM41
fr_tm41.description: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.

fr_tm42.name: TM42
fr_tm42.description: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

fr_tm43.name: TM43
fr_tm43.description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

fr_tm44.name: TM44
fr_tm44.description: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

fr_tm45.name: TM45
fr_tm45.description: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.

fr_tm46.name: TM46
fr_tm46.description: An attack that may take the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.

fr_tm47.name: TM47
fr_tm47.description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s DEFENSE.

fr_tm48.name: TM48
fr_tm48.description: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.

fr_tm49.name: TM49
fr_tm49.description: Steals the effects of the foe’s healing or status- changing move.

fr_tm50.name: TM50
fr_tm50.description: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user’s SP. ATK stat.

fr_oaksparcel.name: Oak’S Parcel
fr_oaksparcel.description: A parcel to be delivered to PROF. OAK from VIRIDIAN CITY’s POKéMON MART.

fr_pokeflute.name: Poké Flute
fr_pokeflute.description: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any POKéMON. It has a lovely tone.

fr_secretkey.name: Secret Key
fr_secretkey.description: The key to CINNABAR ISLAND GYM’s front door. It is colored red and decorated.

fr_bikevoucher.name: Bike Voucher
fr_bikevoucher.description: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.

fr_goldteeth.name: Gold Teeth
fr_goldteeth.description: A set of false teeth lost by the SAFARI ZONE’S WARDEN. It makes his smile sparkle.

fr_oldamber.name: Old Amber
fr_oldamber.description: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an ancient POKéMON. It is clear with a reddish tint.

fr_cardkey.name: Card Key
fr_cardkey.description: A card-type key that unlocks doors in SILPH CO.’s HEAD OFFICE in SAFFRON CITY.

fr_liftkey.name: Lift Key
fr_liftkey.description: A key that operates the elevator in TEAM ROCKET’s HIDEOUT. It bears the TEAM ROCKET logo.

fr_helixfossil.name: Helix Fossil
fr_helixfossil.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a seashell.

fr_domefossil.name: Dome Fossil
fr_domefossil.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a shell.

fr_silphscope.name: Silph Scope
fr_silphscope.description: A scope that makes unseeable POKéMON visible. It is made by SILPH CO.

fr_bicycle.name: Bicycle
fr_bicycle.description: A folding bicycle that allows faster movement than the RUNNING SHOES.

fr_townmap.name: Town Map
fr_townmap.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

fr_vsseeker.name: VS Seeker
fr_vsseeker.description: A device that indicates TRAINERS who want to battle. The battery charges while traveling.

fr_famechecker.name: Fame Checker
fr_famechecker.description: A device that enables you to recall what you’ve heard and seen about famous people.

fr_tmcase.name: TM Case
fr_tmcase.description: A case that holds TMs and HMs. It is attached to the BAG’s compartment for important items.

fr_berrypouch.name: Berry Pouch
fr_berrypouch.description: A pouch for carrying BERRIES. It is attached to the BAG’s compartment for important items.

fr_teachytv.name: Teachy Tv
fr_teachytv.description: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

fr_tripass.name: Tri-Pass
fr_tripass.description: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.

fr_rainbowpass.name: Rainbow Pass
fr_rainbowpass.description: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

fr_tea.name: Tea
fr_tea.description: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.

fr_mysticticket.name: Mysticticket
fr_mysticticket.description: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.

fr_auroraticket.name: Auroraticket
fr_auroraticket.description: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.

fr_powderjar.name: Powder Jar
fr_powderjar.description: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

fr_ruby.name: Ruby
fr_ruby.description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.

fr_sapphire.name: Sapphire
fr_sapphire.description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.

kanto_2_34.policy: Use the original completed-tunnel layout for NXT postgame access. The native coordinates and metatiles are unmodified; no invented collision corridor is carved.

policy: Native FireRed inventory identities are namespaced fr_ to preserve existing Sigma saves. All 425 Kanto and Sevii maps are audited. HMs are excluded. Hidden coins, quantities and underfoot-only Itemfinder rewards retain their packed source semantics. NPC scripts are statically audited; only explicitly supported acquisition conditions are published.

scriptGifts.policy: Acquisition audit; never flatten conditional paths into free pickups.
